cues: One qualification is worth a mark.
Annual rings are reliable only where the growing season is sharply defined.
In the hot, wet Terai, and in the tropics, the cambium may work almost all year, so the rings are faint.
A drought in mid season can even lay down a false ring.
So write: counting rings gives the age of a tree in regions with a distinct growing season.
